Specification: This module specifies the two-phase handshake protocol, a fundamental hardware protocol involving a Producer and a Consumer process that alternate actions, with the Producer acting first. The protocol is modeled with variables representing the state of the Producer (p), Consumer (c), and an abstract data variable (x), with actions for each process and a temporal specification ensuring alternation. The module also demonstrates that this protocol implements the Alternate specification under a refinement mapping, using a function vBar to relate the two, and provides a detailed TLAPS proof of this implementation.
